_comment: PRESTO ComfyUI operational-config deployment contract. Source-controlled canonical bytes (frozen via .gitattributes -text) vs live deployed copies. Verified read-only by --deployment-status; installed ONLY by explicit --deployment-apply (backup + atomic replace + post-write SHA verify); never restarts ComfyUI. The scheduled task 'Presto ComfyUI Server' (boot + 10-min self-heal) executes the task launcher — see wiki/presto-comfyui-server.md.

files.notes: THE production launcher — executed by scheduled task 'Presto ComfyUI Server' (startup + 10-min self-heal, duplicate-protected, log-rotating).
Legacy/manual convenience launcher (2026-07-22), superseded for production by the task launcher on 2026-07-30; kept managed because it remains on disk and executable.
Maps the legacy C:/Users/presto/Documents/ComfyUI model tree into the D: install (the second model root). git-ignored upstream, hence invisible to git status.
